name: Remote · scrcpy
subtitle: Control Android over ADB
promotionalText: Your Android, within reach. Pair wirelessly, control with touch or a full keyboard, and choose how audio travels between your devices.
description:
View and control an Android phone from your iPhone or iPad, using a direct ADB connection and a native interface.

PAIR AND CONNECT
• Android 11+ wireless debugging: pair with a QR code or six-digit code, then connect over TLS.
• Name this device so you can recognize it in Android’s paired-device list.
• Save multiple connection profiles, including address, port and video settings.
• Classic TCP ADB is also supported.

CONTROL FROM YOUR HANDS
• Touch and multitouch, with Back, Home and Recents keys.
• Edge gestures for Android navigation and Quick Settings.
• A six-row QWERTY keyboard with Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win and Fn. Swipe up for symbols or down for capitals.
• Portrait and landscape layouts, optional orientation sync and manual remote rotation.
• H.264 and H.265 video, configurable resolution, bitrate and frame rate.

CHOOSE YOUR AUDIO
• Play the remote Android’s system audio on this device.
• Forward this device’s microphone to Android when you enable it.
• Playback and microphone forwarding have independent switches. Microphone forwarding is off by default.

BEFORE YOU BUY
The controlled device must be Android and must allow ADB debugging. Wireless pairing requires Android 11 or later with Wireless debugging enabled in Developer options. Both devices must be reachable on the network; QR discovery needs the same local network. Classic TCP ADB may require a computer for initial setup. Direct USB connection is not available on iOS.

Audio capture, microphone forwarding and protected content depend on Android version, device policies and the apps being controlled. The session runs while this app is in the foreground.

No account or subscription. No advertising or relay server. Connections are direct between your devices. The source code is available under GPL-3.0.

Setup guide and support: https://scrcpy.oh-my-term.cn/support.html
